dct_description_sm:
This spatial polygon layer contains all the standardized plots used for the Ministry of Natural Resources’ moose aerial inventory program. The geographic area includes Central and Northern Ontario.  These plots are based on the Military Grid Reference System (MGRS) and the coordinates are based on the Universal transverse Mercator (UTM) coordinate system.

Status
Completed: production of the data has been completed
 
Maintenance and Update Frequency
Biannually
